anya: Heads-up — we're introducing a small routing-policy field on internal API v2: `x-rd-route-policy`. It carries affinity hints + soft quota tags. This will change how the SDKs pick default route affinity for streaming/batched requests, so we need to align SDK flags, console attribution, and telemetry mapping.

sam: Is this going to be opt-in or default-on? We should avoid surprising existing customers.

mike: The plan in the RFC was to make it default for new SDK releases but keep a clear opt-out env var for older clients. Implementation note: code will set `x-rd-route-policy: affinity=hint;quota=tenant:bulk` in the request header for batched flows.

liz: Dashboard impact: console charts currently attribute tokens by model + route-id. Adding quota tags will let us show quota-burn per feature flag, but we need to decide the canonical label. Do we surface `tenant:bulk` or map to product-facing `bulk-embeds`?

anya: Good call — propose a small mapping table in console that maps internal quota tags -> product labels. Default mapping: `tenant:bulk` -> `bulk-embeds`, `tenant:interactive` -> `chat-interactive`. We'll add a UI toggle to preview the mapping before GA.

sam: Telemetry question — do we plan to send the full header downstream to observability? PII/tenant leakage risk.

mike: We'll only emit the normalized tag (post-mapping) in traces and ingest as `route.quota_tag`. Raw header never logs. Also add sampling: only 1% of requests include full debug payload (with header) to the debug sink.

anya: For SDKs: propose opt-in boolean `enableRoutePolicyV2` (defaults false in current stable releases). In next major we flip default true, but keep the env var `RD_ROUTE_POLICY=false` as an opt-out. Need changelog + deprecation window.

sam: Agree. Need migration doc for py/ts/go with code examples. Example header: `x-rd-route-policy: affinity=recent;quota=tenant:interactive;ver=2` — include that in docs.

liz: UX ask: add an admin preview page in console that simulates your mapping for a sample set of requests (paste header blob) so customers can validate attribution before we flip defaults.

mike: Implementation notes for SDK teams: 1) add flag and env var 2) runtime picks header only when batching or streaming enters affinity path 3) expose telemetry opt-in for full debug payload (1% sampling). I'll open PRs in python/ts/go repos today.

anya: Timeline suggestion: docs + SDK PRs this week, console mapping UI + small rollout next week to internal canary orgs, 2-week opt-in period, flip default in 1.1.0 release. Also schedule a recording for support.

ci-bot: deploy pipeline triggered for `eng/devex/sdk-routepolicy-canary` — build started 1768454350.

sam: One more thing — add a console alert rule that flags sudden attribution delta > 15% after flip (token distribution drift). We want automatic rollback signal.

anya: Will add rollback metric and a one-click rollback on console. Thanks everyone — I'll draft the migration playbook and drop a link here when ready. :thumbsup:
